title: Google Introduces Android MCP to Enable App Integrations With Gemini

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Google has unveiled a new system that uses the AppFunctions API to allow its Gemini AI assistant to retrieve data and execute specific functions within software installed on its mobile operating system. The framework, known as Android MCP, was announced at the Android Dev Summit and allows developers to create integrations so the AI can perform tasks or answer questions using real-time information from their applications.

The launch follows a preview of the Connected Apps Platform, which provides developers a centralized interface for managing app presence across the company's search engine and AI assistant. The new shift toward the MCP framework is part of a broader effort to transform Android into an "agent-friendly OS" by streamlining how AI assistants interact with third party software on a device.
